idea: Find the fewest coins that add up to an amount. Row i, column a of the table holds the fewest coins for amount a using only the first i coin values. Each cell is the smaller of skipping coin i (the cell above) or using it once more (the cell on the left by the coin's value, plus one coin). Walking back through the table shows which coins were used.
useWhen: Making change with the fewest coins when the greedy choice can fail, for example coins 1, 3, 4 for 6
Counting the cheapest way to build a total from reusable parts
avoidWhen: The coin values are such that greedy is known to be right (like most real currencies): greedy is simpler
The amount is huge: the table grows with it
